newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia to offer industrial sands sites.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia to offer industrial sands sites.

text.p: Tunisia on Tuesday said it offers six sites of industrial silica sands for investments to be sold into glass, foundry, ceramics oil, construction and leisure industries.

Office National des Mines ONM Chairman Adel Ben Ahmed told a Tunisian-British Industrial Sands seminar in Tunis that the sites discovered were at Ain Jezza in northwestern Tunisia, Hydra, Oueslatia and Rmil in central Tunisia, Grimit near the coastal city of Sousse, and Sidi Aich in southern Tunisia.

"We are looking for investors in this sector where Tunisia has a large potential with its six sites, especially that exports possibilities, mainly to Italy, are proven," ONM engineer Habib Mahjoubi said.

The seminar was attended by experts from United Kingdom's supplier of specialist industrial silica material Hepworth Minerals and Chemicals Ltd HMC, Mineral Industry Research Organisation MIRO, and Wardell Amstrong Plc.
